topic: What if Luffy had awakened Gear 5 at Marineford, before Ace died
title: What If Luffy Had Gear 5 At Marineford
description: What if Luffy had Gear 5 at Marineford? Here's how I think the war changes, and why it still might not save Ace. Would you take that trade?
comment: Gear 5 Luffy at Marineford: does Ace live or does the war get worse? Pick one.

lines.text: What if Luffy had Gear 5 at Marineford?

shot.fallback: white haired boy laughing with clouds around him

lines.text: Picture it. Luffy hits the execution platform and his hair turns white.

shot.fallback: boy with white hair and glowing white aura

lines.text: Rubber that bends the rules of the ground itself.

shot.fallback: cartoonish giant fist stretching across a battlefield

lines.text: Akainu swings his magma fist, and it hits something soft, bouncy, and totally unbothered.

shot.fallback: red magma fist striking a bouncing white figure

lines.text: For the first time, Luffy can actually stand in front of Ace.

shot.fallback: two brothers on a stone platform

lines.text: Whitebeard sees it and laughs, because his sons finally have a real chance.

shot.fallback: old giant pirate laughing on a battlefield

lines.text: But here's the catch. Gear 5 didn't come free.

shot.fallback: boy collapsing after a huge transformation

lines.text: At Wano, Luffy passed out after the transformation ended.

shot.fallback: boy lying down exhausted after battle

lines.text: At Marineford, that means he collapses right in the middle of the biggest war in the world.

shot.fallback: huge naval war with a boy falling

lines.text: So Ace lives, but Luffy is dead weight, and the Navy has him on a plate.
Maybe the ending we got was the only one where they both leave.

shot.fallback: two brothers standing together at sunset
